blocking_findings.description: Default-off experiments are not accepted native Voxy LoD integration or delivered renderer.

non_blocking_findings.description: Unreconciled real-LOAD metadata and nullable device replay 0.
A judged sample can be erased and relabelled as a fixed skip with matching logs/counters; replay 0.
Cached real scene is not tied to world-engine identity; same-centre reconnect reuses pre-disconnect geometry.
Scene and atlas cleanup swallow exceptions; zero counters do not prove no leaks.
Atlas snapshot and supplied pixels never reset on reload or disconnect.
Explicit real-LOAD guards survive removal in the unchanged complete focused class.

safe_for_normal_play.scope: All voxy.native.* flags unset from startup: established supported GL preserved; MC Vulkan has disabled Voxy, not native LoD. Source/offline evidence only.

real_load_judgment.scope: Original retained real-section same-matrix visible composition at bracket grain; no nearer-MC occlusion, no delivered renderer.

atlas_judgment.scope: Source/layout and committed bounded Blaze3D execution; raw GL branch unchanged in unflagged sessions.

instance_mode_judgment.scope: CPU engine/storage/ingest and camera capture without VoxyRenderSystem; complete inventories in both launches.

terrain_load_judgment.scope: 11 assigned synthetic terrain samples; declared depth state, bracket grain.

coexist_judgment.scope: 22 known-depth quad samples; exact RGB pass/fail against MC loaded depth.

z_direction_judgment.scope: Same-ground two-look bounded reverse-Z direction; not metric depth calibration.

ladder_judgment.scope: 22 selected/rejected samples, per-pixel recount/thumbnail anchors and single-consumer alternating handoff.
